newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan stainless steel exports seen dull in Q4 - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan stainless steel exports seen dull in Q4 - MITI.

text.p: Plentiful supplies of stainless steel in the Asian market will continue to depress demand for Japanese exports in the fourth quarter of this year, an official of Japan's Ministry of International Trade and Industry said on Thursday.

The ministry projected Japan's stainless steel exports at 83,900 tonnes per month in the October-December quarter, up 7.5 percent from the same quarter last year but down 5.3 percent from this year's July-September quarter.
"Taiwan and Europe have aggressively entered the Southeast Asian market," noted the MITI official.

Domestic Japanese demand for stainless steel in the October-December quarter was projected at 180,300 tonnes per month, off 2.2 percent from the same period last year but up 1.3 percent from the July-September quarter.
The official blamed the year-on-year drop in domestic demand on unusually strong demand last year related to rebuilding after the Kobe earthquake.
